data.one_liner: Parses and formats ISO 8601 duration strings into individual duration parts.
data.what_it_does: A package that parses ISO 8601 duration formats (PnYnMnDTnHnMnS) into a dedicated IsoDuration object. It allows developers to extract individual duration components, calculate total seconds, perform formatting, and manipulate DateTimes.
use_when: You need to parse ISO 8601 duration responses from REST APIs.
You want to add or subtract ISO 8601 durations from Dart DateTime objects.
You need to format duration intervals into readable strings.
avoid_when: You only need standard Dart core Durations without ISO string parsing.
strengths: Supports parsing negative durations and decimals (with comma and dots).
Provides helper methods for DateTime manipulation and formatting.
weaknesses: Limited to ISO 8601 duration parsing and formatting.
data.minimal_example:
final dur = IsoDuration.parse('PT36H');
dur.hours; // 36.0
dur.toSeconds(); // 129600.0
dur.toIso(); // 'PT36H'
